title: Blush Framework entry
description: An entry's front matter: the fields every entry understands. Content types and taxonomies add their own.

subtitle.description: A line shown under the title.

slug.description: The URL name, instead of the file name.

published.description: The publish date, such as 2026-09-26 09:00:00 -05:00. A date in the future schedules the entry.

date.description: Same as published. The publish date, such as 2026-09-26 09:00:00 -05:00. A date in the future schedules the entry.

updated.description: When it last changed; defaults to published, then the file's modified time.

trashed.description: When the entry was moved to the trash, set with status: trash.

summary.description: A short Markdown summary for listings and feeds. Without one, the first 50 words are used.

excerpt.description: Same as summary. A short Markdown summary for listings and feeds. Without one, the first 50 words are used.

locale.description: The entry's locale, such as fr_CA, when it isn't the site's.

template.description: The theme template to use, such as single-wide.

view.description: Same as template. The theme template to use, such as single-wide.

stylesheet.description: An extra stylesheet for this page.

class.description: Extra CSS classes for the page's <body>.

redirect_from.description: Old URLs that should redirect here.

collection.description: Lists other entries on this page.

id.description: The entry's id, a UUID, kept last. Blush writes it; content:ids adds a missing one.
